description: This file defines interfaces and related structures for composition management in a graphics framework, including classes for composition, client, rendering, notification, display, and brightness control.

classes.name: IComposition
classes.description: Interface for managing composition layers, resolution, and related properties.

classes.name: IComposition::IClient
classes.description: Interface representing a client layer within the composition, with properties like opacity, geometry, and Z-order.

classes.name: IComposition::IClient::IProperties
classes.description: Interface for properties of a composition client, including stride, format, offset, and modifier.

classes.name: IComposition::IRender
classes.description: Interface for rendering operations such as scan out.

classes.name: IComposition::INotification
classes.description: Interface for composition event notifications, such as attachment and detachment of clients.

classes.name: IComposition::IDisplay
classes.description: Interface for display management, including resolution and client creation.

classes.name: IBrightness
classes.description: Interface for controlling display brightness settings, especially in HDR contexts.

methods.name: RefreshRateFromResolution
methods.description: Calculates refresh rate from a given screen resolution.

methods.name: WidthFromResolution
methods.description: Extracts width from a screen resolution.

methods.name: HeightFromResolution
methods.description: Extracts height from a screen resolution.

methods.name: ResolutionFromHeightWidth
methods.description: Creates a ScreenResolution object from height and width.

methods.name: SdrToHdrGraphicsBrightness
methods.description: Gets or sets the SDR to HDR graphics brightness level.
